payload.title: Target-VPS Qwen3.5 vision scale + libmtmd feature-tap falsifier
payload.work_clay: First refresh exact accepted target-VPS RAM/swap/storage/GPU/backend state, llama.cpp build and available Qwen3.5 0.8B/2B/4B GGUF+mmproj artifacts. Then, only without displacing the active ClayCode BASE critical path, run fixed-image fixed-token encode-only and decoder-inclusive scale measurements. Instrument libmtmd so one encoded media buffer can be observed by a bounded feature descriptor/MVC and optionally passed to decoder processing; count actual vision encode invocations. Compare raw pooled Qwen features, tiny projected Qwen features and a dedicated lightweight embedding baseline under identical familiarity/open-set fixtures. Treat runtime build/flags as causal variables. No architecture promotion from literature or proxy evidence.
payload.reason_clay: Fresh official Qwen3.5 configs show 2B and 4B share essentially the same 24-layer hidden-1024 vision tower while 0.8B uses a materially smaller 12-layer hidden-768 tower. Current Transformers/libmtmd code exposes a pre-decoder media-feature boundary, making one-encode reuse executable. Current llama.cpp issue evidence also shows multimodal correctness/latency can depend on runtime configuration. The next high-value falsifier is therefore target-VPS measurement, not more narrative synthesis.
payload.completion_clay: Exact target-host resource receipt exists; model/mmproj/runtime hashes are bound; runtime sanity matrix is executed; 0.8B/2B/4B encode-only and full-path raw rows include cold/warm p50/p95/p99 plus CPU/RSS/swap and token counts; feature-tap run proves or refutes one-encode reuse with an invocation counter; raw/projected/dedicated embedding variants are compared on false-familiar, missed-familiar, unknown rejection, calibration, task success and resources; crash/restart/version-swap controls execute; each q23 hypothesis receives SUPPORTED/REFINED/REFUTED/NO_CHANGE; no BASE/H1/H2/H3 credit is granted except from the exact acceptance contract receipts that independently qualify.
payload.executor_policy: Use a capable non-overlapping worker with accepted target-VPS execution access. Do not displace or slow WORK-CLAYCODE-BASE14-CLOSE-20260809; execute only with spare target capacity or when the same observation directly unblocks a BASE/Harness requirement. Refresh current repo/head, work revisions and target capability before effect. No paid/final training. self.root/Frank has proposal-only Harness authority.
